title: India's Junior Squad Prepares for BWF World Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for the development and preparation of India's top junior badminton talent for a major international event.
summary: The National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for the Indian squad ahead of the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Hosts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This initiative aims to elevate the coaching standards across India, directly impacting the quality of future Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India conducted an advanced Level-1 coaches course at NCE Guwahati and Raipur, concluding on September 23rd.

title: Indian Junior Teams Train for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's promising young shuttlers for regional junior championships, fostering future international success.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian teams participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Indian Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact the competitive landscape and strategic development of young Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: BWF World Junior Championships 2026: Selection Trial Qualifiers Announced
indian_angle: This announcement details the pathway for Indian junior players to represent the nation at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The list of eligible players and those who have qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt, has been released.
